record.paper_title: Boundary and Defect CFT: Open Problems and Applications
record.original_question: Can the bootstrap analysis of conformal field theories on real projective space be extended to holographic or otherwise strongly coupled theories such as N = 4 super Yang-Mills theory or Liouville theory, and if so does it agree with the corresponding holographic predictions?

evidence.quote: In the future, it would be interesting to study holographic models such as N = 4 super Yang-Mills theory or Liouville theory and compare them with the holographic predictions.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider a conformal field theory (CFT) defined on the real projective space $\mathbb{RP}^d$, obtained as the quotient of $\mathbb{R}^d$ (or $S^d$) by the antipodal involution $x \mapsto -x/|x|^2$. On such an unorientable background, one-point functions of bulk primary operators $\mathcal{O}_\Delta$ are not forced to vanish; conformal symmetry fixes them to take the form
$$\langle \mathcal{O}_\Delta(x)\rangle_{\mathbb{RP}^d} = \frac{A_{\mathcal{O}}}{(1+|x|^2)^{\Delta}},$$
and two-point functions of bulk primaries depend nontrivially on a cross-ratio invariant under the antipodal map. The "projective-space bootstrap" consists of constraints obtained by expanding such two-point functions in two distinct OPE channels (the bulk OPE and the image-point/crosscap channel) and demanding consistency, yielding equations that determine the coefficients $A_{\mathcal{O}}$ in terms of the bulk CFT data.

Problem. Extend this projective-space bootstrap program to strongly coupled or holographic conformal field theories — in particular to four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang–Mills theory placed on $\mathbb{RP}^4$, and to two-dimensional Liouville theory placed on $\mathbb{RP}^2$. Compute the crosscap one-point coefficients $A_{\mathcal{O}}$ (for example, for $\tfrac{1}{2}$-BPS operators in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM) and the corresponding two-point functions, and determine whether the resulting bootstrap predictions agree with the holographic computations obtained from the appropriate gravitational dual (e.g. type IIB supergravity on $AdS_5\times S^5$ with an orientifold-like involution dual to $\mathbb{RP}^4$).
artifact.category_tag: conformal bootstrap on real projective space
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work has carried out this program for $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM on $\mathbb{RP}^4$: a holographic dual was constructed in 5d $\mathcal{N}=8$ gauged supergravity and uplifted to a 1/2-BPS type IIB solution (Wang, 2022, JHEP 2023), and bootstrap-based computations of two-point functions of 1/2-BPS operators at strong coupling were performed and found consistent with the holographic predictions (PRL 133, 201602, 2024). The Liouville-on-$\mathbb{RP}^2$ side does not appear to be fully addressed in the same comparative way, so the broader question is partially resolved.

status_evidence.title: Holography for N=4 on RP^4
status_evidence.snippet: Holographic dual to N=4 SYM on RP^4 constructed in 5d gauged supergravity and uplifted to type IIB; matches bootstrap motivations.
status_evidence.claim: The holographic side of the question for N=4 SYM on RP^4 has been worked out.

status_evidence.title: Correlators of N=4 SYM on Real Projective Space at Strong Coupling
status_evidence.snippet: Bootstrap techniques used to determine two-point functions of 1/2-BPS operators in N=4 SYM on RP^4 at leading order in large-N.
status_evidence.claim: Bootstrap analysis of N=4 SYM on RP^4 has been performed and compared with holography.

status_evidence.title: Conformal bootstrap in Liouville Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Mathematical proof of the conformal bootstrap in Liouville theory on the sphere/plane.
status_evidence.claim: Liouville bootstrap is well developed on orientable surfaces, but the RP^2 crosscap version is not analogously matched to a holographic dual in the literature found.
